name: clawmem
description: ClawMem durable memory bundle for Codex. Installs the Codex-specific ClawMem memory protocol skill and connects Codex to the hosted ClawMem MCP service.

interface.longDescription: ClawMem adds repo-aware durable memory to Codex. The bundled skill and hooks drive memory-first recall, wiki context-map background, and deliberate save, update, and forget actions after meaningful work, while the hosted MCP service executes memory operations against the ClawMem backend.
